NARACOORTE | SOUTH AUSTRALIA THE LIMESTONE COAST
Camp beneath the
shady gums
beside a water hole stocked with Silver Perch and Redfin
Camp beneath shady gum trees beside a water hole stocked with Silver Perch and Redfin.
Experience bush walking, bird watching and enjoy the flora and fauna.
An easy walking trail meanders through virgin scrub, view colourful native flowers and orchids throughout the park. The marked trail starts at the camp ground.
Use our campground as a base to explore the wineries at Coonawarra and Padthaway,
part of the scenic Limestone Coast or visit the World Heritage listed Naracoorte Caves.
All can be visited comfortably within a day trip.
Make your own pizza with our wood fired pizza oven.
Barbeques, tables, flush toilets, hot showers and limited powered sites provided in a natural setting.
Pets welcome at our discretion. Dump site available.
Enquiries and bookings: 0428 621 613
